Veteran Malayalam Cinematographer T.N. Krishnankutty Dies at 96

Veteran Malayalam cinematographer T.N. Krishnankutty passed away at the age of 96 in Alappuzha. He had a career spanning over several decades and worked in more than 70 films in Malayalam cinema.
